scope: first structural card of the B line: dedicated correction adapter (4 born tensors, 408 scalars) plus the record channel are the only trainable parameters; every emission parameter is frozen during feedback

lineage.parent_bundles: A.5 pre-feedback bundles, one per seed, byte-identical

born.init: first layer from the continuation of the seeded stream; last layer zero => exactly neutral at birth

read_code.rule: zeros(24); code[class] = 1.0; both branches receive the same code at joint_readout
read_code.injection: forward hook on joint_readout replaces its output with joint_readout(code); training, evaluation and feedback use the same path
read_code.limitation: the code carries the read's four-way answer, not the scene's pixels; a pass measures byte expression, not content-conditioned binding

task_b.definition: fact revision: the environment legally releases a record stating the queried entity's new position; the answer target is that new position; the first pass only sees the read and is wrong by construction
task_b.template_rule: the answer word must land at a different byte offset in each template; with a single template every record puts the answer at byte 21, and 'copy bytes 21..27' would pass the gate without reading the fact
task_b.counter_fact_arm: a second arm releases a record whose answer contradicts the truth; a subject that reads the record must answer differently, a fixed-offset copier cannot

measured_headroom.note: the gain is not zero by construction; an update has something to buy

measured_content_sensitivity.note: the channel reacts to the answer word (delta 0.47) but the copy position does not yet point at it (entropy 3.40 over thirty positions), so there is real work for an update to do

measured_protocol_limits.unseen_query: routing is numerically but not operationally query-sensitive: a paraphrase moves route mass by 1e-6, so an unseen-query gate cannot rest on routing; the unseen query is therefore measured by changing the request wording and the template, and by scoring only rounds whose wording was never released
measured_protocol_limits.cross_session: records, released ids and fast memory all survive a save/reload boundary and routing after reload equals routing before (0.527698 / 0.472302)
measured_protocol_limits.multi_fact: with two records released the route is query-blind (0.345389 against 0.345390), so task B is single-fact per episode by design

measured_gate_structure.note: the copy gate is a function of the read code only, so it cannot switch on the presence of a record; the switch has to come from the record route and the copy position, which are the parameters this card trains

criteria.question: can correction and retention hold at once when the update path is separated from the emission parameters
criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.denominator: the 24 first-pass fit errors per seed, same subject, same template assignment
criteria.retention_is_not_tautological: the adapter sits on the shared output path and is NOT gated on record presence; smoke must prove that perturbing it changes the A answer digest. Without the adapter the record channel is outside the A graph and retention could not fail (the A.5 trap)
criteria.bootstrap: world-paired per example (learned - control), 2000 resamples, seed 20261116, 95% lower bound > 0
criteria.stability: first-pass correct to second-pass wrong <= max(1, 0.10 * first-pass correct)
criteria.seed_rule: a positive exit requires correction >= gate, damage <= gate and gain >= gate on all three seeds
criteria.protocol: A.6 amendment (D-20261116-05/06): one error released at a time, k=8 updates per error, no rollback, immediate diagnostic re-ask, final full pass for the gate
criteria.counterfactual_arm: the counter record (third position) must be followed at >= 0.8 on every seed that reaches the correction gate; a fixed-offset copier or a record-blind shortcut cannot pass
criteria.knockout_arm: with the correction verification cut: B accuracy <= first pass + 0.05 and A digest == baseline digest; proves the adapter carries the correction and the cut restores v4 exactly
criteria.control_arm: zero-update control: at least 3 legally released exposure episodes (full option: all 24), parameters bit-identical, and the second pass over all 24 questions == first pass; exposure without updates cannot change anything, the arm proves it
criteria.path_purity: all 176 non-trainable base tensors bit-identical to the start bundle; the 8 emission tensors (3919 scalars) stay frozen throughout
criteria.recovery: independent process reloads the post-feedback bundle; 32 A rounds plus 24 B rounds byte-identical
criteria.teacher_forcing: forbidden at evaluation; record_loss uses teacher forcing for the loss only (declared, as in A.5/A.6)
criteria.start_state: A.5 pre-feedback bundle per seed, byte-identical; v6 inherits 194 tensors and 4 adapter tensors are born zero-neutral

criteria_canonicalization: json.dumps(criteria, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')) utf-8 sha256
limitations: the read-code hook still cuts the fast path (A.2); B.1 does not repair the read gap, the main term rides the injected calibrated read (A.1b-cal, post hoc; independent cross-half minimum 0.844)
a positive result signs mechanism reachability under this configuration, not a general learning capability and not a parent
the record value readout was dead in the v4 output path; the adapter gives it its first causal consumer
seeds only vary the cache-position consumption order (weak repetition, as in A.5)
k=8 is the only dose that produced correction in A.6; B.1 does not re-measure the dose curve
note: criteria frozen before any formal training (amendment v2: control exposure parametrized to >=3 episodes for the lean option, still before any formal reading; criteria_sha256 recomputed). The pricing gate rejected full_3seed on the final measurement (cap 626.175 > design cap 600); lean_3seed selected at cap 562.943 CPU / 1125.886 wall, within the 600/1200 design cap. The design cap was not raised. smoke passed on all three seeds (0 optimizer steps); price measured on a discarded model (8 pricing steps). Training not authorized.

wiring_cost.note: pre-authorization wiring and pricing, accounted separately from the formal cap. Earlier smoke/price pairs were superseded by runner edits and rerun; the final archived pair was produced by the pinned runner except for one run-mode-only edit afterwards (control exposure parametrization), which does not touch the smoke or price code paths.
